summary: Tested UI enhancements for Our Tasks and HR Admin modules. All features working correctly: Our Tasks has 'Assigned to Me' and 'Assign to Team' tabs with filters, HR Admin Employees shows summary stats and list view with Work Mode column, Calendar > Holidays tab renamed and has month/year filter, Approvals shows detailed attendance and WFH request views.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UI enhancements tested and working. Our Tasks page has two main tabs (Assigned to Me/Assign to Team) with full filter support. HR Admin Employees tab shows summary stats (Total/Office/Remote) and list view with Work Mode column. Calendar > Holidays tab renamed from 'Indian Holidays' and has month/year filter. Approvals section shows detailed attendance and WFH request cards with all fields.

our_tasks_assigned_to_me_tab.details: Tab shows tasks assigned to current user with Start button, count badge (4), and full filters (Date, Assigned To, Assigned By, Type, Status)

our_tasks_assign_to_team_tab.details: Tab shows tasks created by user and assigned to others with status badges only (no Start button), count badge (0), and full filters

our_tasks_filters.details: All filters present: Date (All Time dropdown), Assigned To, Assigned By, Type (All Types), Status (All Status)

hr_admin_employees_summary_stats.details: Summary stats showing Total Employees (10), Office (2), Remote (0) with icons and descriptions

hr_admin_employees_list_view.details: Employees List table with columns: Employee, Role, Department, Work Mode, Status, Actions. Work Mode shows Office/Remote badges

hr_admin_calendar_holidays_tab_renamed.details: Tab renamed from 'Indian Holidays' to 'Holidays' - verified 'Indian Holidays' text not present

hr_admin_calendar_holidays_month_year_fi.details: Month dropdown and Year input present in Holidays sub-tab, filtering holidays by selected month/year

hr_admin_approvals_attendance_detailed_v.details: Attendance approvals show avatar, work mode badge (Office), date, time, check in/out fields, reason, and Approve/Reject buttons

hr_admin_approvals_remote_tab.details: Remote/WFH tab working with filters (Status, Employee, Date Range) and detailed WFH request cards showing all fields
